messages:
maya: quick design prompt: new compact timeline layout for the Usage view. idea = horizontal time axis at top, vertical project rows, each row has a small sparkline, a one-line token summary, and a chevron to expand a right-side invoice & token flyout. mock: https://redwood.app/figma/compact-tl :sparkles:

 darren: I like horizontal time at the top for scan speed. concern: when many projects exist, rows get cramped. can we collapse low-activity projects by default? maybe an "auto-collapse" based on threshold.

 sarah: accessibility heads-up: sparklines need >4.5:1 contrast for both light/dark. also make sure the chevrons have aria-labels like "Open invoices for Project X". avoid relying on hover-only affordances.

 kevin: exporting is a must: CFO wants per-project CSV and invoice bulk-download. suggest an action menu on each row (tool) with Export CSV / Download last 12 invoices. also prefer flyout over inline panels so they don't push content and keyboard focus stays predictable.

 maya: good note. clarifying: expand opens right flyout; flyout shows recent invoices (list), token breakdown (text/embed/rerank), and quick actions (Download PDF, Export CSV, Open Billing page). default row shows totals: 7-day sparkline, 30-day token count, $30-day spend estimate.

 darren: perf: don't fetch invoice PDFs until user clicks download. lazy-load details and show a spinner. virtualization for rows is required. when flyout opens, fetch invoice list + token details via details_url.

 sarah: copy tweak: change "Token count" -> "Token usage"; change "Estimate" -> "Projected spend (30d)". date format for invoice list should be ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) for screen readers.

 kevin: keyboard flow: focusable row chevron, Enter/Space opens flyout, Escape closes it, focus trap inside flyout with visible focus ring. add aria-expanded on chevron and aria-controls pointing to flyout id.

 maya: small API sketch for eng:

```
GET /api/v1/usage/timeline?start=2026-02-01&end=2026-02-28&scope=org
Response: 
  summary_line: "Org: $9,876.54 | 124,345 tokens",
  rows: [ { key: "proj_abc", name: "Payments", sparkline: "s1_base64", tokens_30d: "12345", spend_30d: "$1,234.56", details_url: "/api/v1/usage/proj_abc/details?start=..." } ]
```

 kevin: prefer removing large base64 sparklines from main payload. return small SVG path or sparkline seed + a render endpoint. keep rows lightweight.

 darren: layout suggestion: add a sticky aggregate bar at top that shows Org total + a scope toggle (Org / Project / Custom). keep it visible while scrolling.

 sarah: a11y micro: tooltip copy for scope toggle should be concise e.g., "Show account totals" not "workspace". and ensure tooltips are keyboard accessible.

 billing-bot: New invoice processed: rwd-20260228-321 (amount $1,234.56) -> https://billing.redwood/invoices/rwd-20260228-321 :receipt:

 maya: thanks for the invoice ping. UX decision needed: show the most recent invoice inline in the flyout header with a small PDF icon + aria-label that includes number and amount. detail list below.

 kevin: QA checklist before shipping mock:
 - row virtualization test with 2k projects
 - contrast check + colorblind simulation
 - keyboard nav and focus order test
 - network throttling for lazy loads
 - CSV/PDF export UX (confirm size warnings)
 - screenreader sweep for flyout and chevron labels

 darren: for mobile: stack timeline under a single accordion per project. probably hide sparklines on narrow widths and show a compact sparkline icon that opens a detailed view.

 sarah: last copy nit: in the flyout header use "Recent invoice" not "Latest invoice" (less telegraphic). small but helpful for localization.

 maya: I'll prepare two Figma variants: 1) compact rows + flyout (default) 2) compact rows + inline-most-recent (for power users). will include keyboard prototype and the API contract. aiming to share tomorrow morning for feedback. :rocket:
